products.name: Ethereal Blush
products.desc: Garden roses and peonies in the softest blush, dusty rose, and ivory tones.
products.fullDesc: A breathtaking arrangement of garden roses and peonies in the softest blush, dusty rose, and ivory tones. Each stem is hand-selected for its vase life and bloom perfection, delivering a bouquet that looks — and feels — like a dream.
products.care: Trim stems at a 45° angle and place in fresh, cool water. Change water every 2 days. Keep away from direct sunlight and drafts.
products.seoDesc: Shop our handcrafted blush rose and peony bouquet — romantic, fragrant, and perfect for weddings and anniversaries.

products.name: Forest Sage
products.desc: Eucalyptus, fern, and white hellebore — a verdant, minimalist statement.
products.fullDesc: A contemporary greenery arrangement for the modern aesthetic. Eucalyptus, fern, and white hellebore arranged in a cool, herbal composition that brings the calm of the forest indoors. Effortlessly beautiful and long-lasting.
products.care: Mist lightly every few days. Keep in a cool area away from heat and direct sunlight. No water trimming needed for eucalyptus.
products.seoDesc: A minimalist greenery bouquet featuring eucalyptus, fern, and white hellebore. Perfect for modern spaces and corporate gifting.

products.name: Violet Dream
products.desc: Lavender, wisteria, and lilac in a cascading lilac masterpiece.
products.fullDesc: A deeply aromatic, dreamy arrangement that fills any room with the scent of a Provençal garden. Lavender, wisteria, and lilac cascade together in rich violet and soft purple tones — romantic, calming, and unforgettable.
products.care: Keep in a cool room away from heat. Change water every 2 days. Lavender can also be dried and kept indefinitely.
products.seoDesc: A cascading lavender, wisteria and lilac bouquet — deeply aromatic and dreamy. Perfect for birthdays and self-care gifts.

products.name: Ivory Garden
products.desc: Classic white and cream wedding centrepiece.
products.fullDesc: Timeless, elegant, and endlessly romantic. The Ivory Garden is our most requested wedding bouquet — white roses, baby's breath, ranunculus, and eucalyptus arranged in a classic cascade that photographs beautifully from every angle.
products.care: Keep stems in cool water. Trim every 2 days at a 45° angle. Keep away from heat and ethylene-producing fruit.
products.seoDesc: Classic white and cream wedding bouquet with roses, ranunculus, baby's breath and eucalyptus. Our most-requested bridal arrangement.

reviews.comment: Absolutely breathtaking! The Ethereal Blush arrived in perfect condition — every stem was fresh and the arrangement was even more beautiful than the photos. Lasted 12 days in the vase. Will definitely order again.
Love the minimalist vibe of Forest Sage. The eucalyptus smells amazing and it looks stunning on my desk. Deducting one star only because one fern stem was slightly wilted on arrival.
Ordered for my wife's anniversary. She cried happy tears! The packaging alone is a gift — wrapped so beautifully. FloraLab has a customer for life.
Violet Dream is exactly that — a dream. The scent fills the entire room. I keep getting compliments from guests.
